reason: Mechanism confirmed at HEAD 2e23b46 and independently reproduced on three surfaces (store API, propagation CopyString path, request body-adoption path): Store.Lookup fills its four-entry candidate window with unvalidated matching slots before owner/root liveness validation (lookup.go:117-129), so four stale (finished-owner) slots can hide a fifth live owner and return an empty snapshot while MayContain still reports a hit. However, the state requires five owners holding index slots on the same address key simultaneously: putWindow reclaims dead-owner same-key slots on the next insert (proven by control test), default DD_IAST_MAX_CONCURRENT_REQUESTS=2 caps concurrent owners, and every woven adoption site (source taints, propagation fanout, writer and reader/body publishes) caps same-address adoptions at MaxSnapshotOwners=4 via fixed refs/snapshot arrays, so customer-reachable code cannot construct it. Not a documented limitation (the authors' own test asserts stale entries must not hide live owners). Real internal-contract false negative, unreachable from customer code: Medium, not High.
